name: CSCore
description: Official source: filoe/cscore master (its NuGet 1.2.1.2 dates from 2017 and lacks CodecFactory.GetCodec(Stream, string)). Library patches: Yellow Dog Man's WasapiOut/MMDevice additions the engine's WASAPI driver uses (update events, actual output format, padding, ComputeLatency, AbortOnZeroData, cross-process session, session GUID), ILUtils on System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe (upstream compiles '#if IL' segments with an ildasm/ilasm tool) and the session GUID passed by pointer (LPCGUID). [CSCalli] stubs are woven into calli after compiling ("calli").
